caption: The drawing depicts a single blue glass jar or vase positioned centrally on a plain beige or off-white background. The jar is bulbous with a narrow neck and a slightly flared, rounded rim. Its body is decorated with an overall geometric, diamond-patterned texture, rendered in varying shades of blue to illustrate depth, transparency, and the reflective quality of glass. The top rim and neck are depicted in solid blue tones, while the faceted body shows a mix of light and dark blues indicating the light source and the facets’ angles. There are no additional objects or decorative elements in the composition outside of the jar, and no background details aside from the neutral backdrop.
title: Christmas Tree Light
